findings.quote: "fen":"7k/8/8/1p3p2/8/8/8/R5K1 w - - 0 1" ... "Roll your rook across the board and capture both black pawns before your moves run out."
findings.why: In this FEN the rook is on a1 and the black pawns are on b4 and f4. A rook on a1 can only move along the a-file and the 1st rank; neither b4 nor f4 lies on either line, and the rook cannot turn a corner mid-move. The goal 'capture both black pawns' is impossible in this position no matter how many moves are allowed.
findings.truth: The pawns must be placed on the rook's lines, e.g. rook a1 with black pawns on a5 and h1 (or rook d4 with pawns on d7 and f4 as in other blocks), so that both captures are actually reachable.
findings.sonnet_reason: The pawns are on b5 and f5, not b4 and f4, and the rook can capture both over several moves (e.g. Ra5 then Rxb5 and Rxf5 along rank 5, or Rb1 then Rxb5), so the goal within 12 moves is achievable.
